summary: Example inventory: `[automationcontroller]`, `[automationgateway]` and `[database]` hosts plus `[all:vars]` with `admin_password`, `redis_mode=standalone`, `pg_host`/`pg_port`/`pg_database='awx'`/`pg_username`/`pg_password`, `pg_sslmode='prefer'` (`verify-full` to enforce), `registry_url='registry.redhat.io'` with credentials, and `automationgateway_admin_password` and `automationgateway_pg_*`; optional `automationgateway_main_url`, SSL cert and `postgres_use_ssl` settings are commented.
questions: Example inventory for platform gateway and controller RPM install
Default pg_sslmode in the AAP inventory

answer_card.title: Gateway + controller + database inventory
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[automationcontroller]
controller.example.com
[automationgateway]
gateway.example.com
[database]
data.example.com

[all:vars]
admin_password='<password>'
redis_mode=standalone
pg_host='data.example.com'
pg_port=5432
pg_database='awx'
pg_username='awx'
pg_password='<password>'
pg_sslmode='prefer'   # verify-full to enforce
registry_url='registry.redhat.io'
registry_username='<registry username>'
registry_password='<registry password>'
automationgateway_admin_password='<password>'
automationgateway_pg_host='data.example.com'
automationgateway_pg_port=5432
automationgateway_pg_database='automationgateway'
automationgateway_pg_username='automationgateway'
automationgateway_pg_password='<password>'
automationgateway_pg_sslmode='prefer'
```
